summary: Full backend + frontend verification of the NEW bundle-as-tool feature (Stages 1, 2, 3) using the Pro account mechanicltz@gmail.com on the default STEEL/industrial skin. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases PASS in test_bundles_v3.py (create bundle tool, inside-items CRUD, search-by-inside-name/model surfaces parent, is_bundle filter, expansion link/unlink + inventory visibility, inside items NOT exposed as standalone tools, migration idempotent, claim mirror for inside-item-break carries inside_item_name/model + bundle_model, whole-set break has no inside fields). Frontend: end-to-end E2E PASS on real public URL. Verified: (1) Dashboard ADD ITEM (quick-add-item) opens AddChooser with add-choose-item and add-choose-bundle. (2) Tapping add-choose-bundle creates a new bundle-tool and routes to /tool/<id>?startEdit=1 — confirmed redirect + edit-mode form (edit-brand/edit-model-0/edit-serial-0/edit-cost/edit-qty + edit-save-bar). (3) After save, the detail page shows the 'Set' tab (testID tab-bundle) alongside Details/Photos/Documents/Maintenance/Warranty/History. (4) Set tab content (BundleTab) shows 'ITEMS IN THIS SET' + 'EXPANSION ITEMS' + 'COMBINED TOTAL' section. (5) add-inside-item-btn opens form with inside-name / inside-model / inside-cost → inside-save creates inside row with inside-edit-<id> and inside-del-<id>. (6) add-expansion-btn opens expansion-search picker listing picker-item-<id> rows; tapping one links it; expansion-unlink-<id> appears. Totals updated to Set price $0.00 + Expansion items $25.00 = COMBINED TOTAL $25.00. (7) Inventory list shows the SET / BUNDLE badge on bundle rows and the SET ADD-ON badge on expansion-of rows (visually confirmed in the ryan-style inventory listing). (8) tool-menu-btn opens action menu with menu-edit/move/checkout/broken/stolen/list-sale/export/delete; menu-broken on a bundle with inside items opens the 'WHAT BROKE?' sheet with both broken-whole-set and broken-inside-<id>. Choosing the inside item then opens the repair sheet with banner text 'Claim for inside item: UI_inside_pc (Model #: UI_INSIDE_MD)'. Backend claim mirror on PUT /api/tools/{bid} with repair_info.inside_item_* + needs_repair=true populates inside_item_name / inside_item_model / bundle_model on the warranty-claims row (verified in test_mark_broken_inside_item_creates_claim_with_mirror_fields). Whole-set break creates the claim with no inside-item fields (verified). Default skin = STEEL/industrial — all screens rendered in TbvFrame steel chrome.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still spams 'textShadow*'/'shadow*'/'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings (pre-existing, unrelated to bundle work). Reference: any screen on web preview.

verified_features: Backend pytest 8/8 PASS (test_bundles_v3.py): create bundle-tool, inside CRUD, search-by-inside-name/model surfaces parent, is_bundle filter, expansion link/unlink + inventory visibility, inside items hidden from /tools list, migrate idempotent, claim mirror on inside-item break, whole-set break has no inside fields.

STAGE 3 UI: Dashboard quick-add-item → AddChooser → add-choose-bundle creates /tool/<id>?startEdit=1 with edit form open.
STAGE 3 UI: tab-bundle ('Set' tab) renders with ITEMS IN THIS SET + EXPANSION ITEMS + COMBINED TOTAL (correct math).

Use Pro account mechanicltz@gmail.com / Blue321! to avoid 15-tool free limit.
